title: Partner Sales Manager - IHV Alliances
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Partner Sales Manager to be a key contributing team member within the growing IHV alliances organization. Large OEM or Independent Hardware Vendor (IHV) brands - Dell, HPE, IBM, Lenovo, Ericsson, Cisco, Fujitsu and many more - are major partners for Canonical. These companies build software‑defined solutions to capitalize on global open source mandates and associated macro trends. Canonical's flagship product, Ubuntu, and its broader open source portfolio are key ingredients for these partners to realize their aspirations. Canonical represents the best platform for rapid open source innovation.

Reporting to the Head of IHV Alliances, the Partner Sales Manager will work closely with IHV and Canonical teams in various geographies to enable IHV teams, generate and transact opportunities, drive a Canonical agenda within an IHV, and achieve targeted results. They are responsible to build trusted relationships with our partners, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelize the partnership and drive business interactions from across persona - from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and participate in executive engagements.

Location

This is a remote role.

The role entails

  • Build strategic relationships and enable partner teams on the partnership
  • Build pipeline and transact opportunities through an IHV
  • Grow partner awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem
  • Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
  • Travel regularly - sometimes internationally - to drive partnerships in person
  • Align and support internal canonical field teams - identify, support, grow, transact
  • Expand existing footprint with IHV customers with an aim to upsell to broader portfolio
  • Support and contribute to broader strategy, initiatives and key campaigns

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands‑on, get‑it‑done mentality
  • Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
  • Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast‑paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals
  • Experience with Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Team player with superior accountability and customer support skills
  • Credibility and working knowledge of IHVs - their products, go‑to‑market motion, and field
  • Experience managing cross‑functional teams and track record of operational excellence
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
  • Hands on experience with Salesforce and Google Suite a plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Descrição da vaga

A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado.

Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.

Ser diverso é ser Super!

Esta oportunidade também está publicada no portal global de vagas da SHV Energy e faz parte do nosso compromisso de atrair talentos que compartilham dos nossos valores, independente da localização.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Objetivo do Cargo:

Atuar como especialista funcional em produtos digitais e aplicativos , garantindo a tradução precisa das necessidades de usuários e negócio em requisitos claros, priorizáveis e implementáveis, suportando todo o ciclo de discovery, delivery e evolução contínua do produto em ambientes ágeis.

Responsabilidades:

Discovery e entendimento do usuário

  • Conduzir discovery orientado a produto , explorando problemas, oportunidades, hipóteses e métricas de sucesso.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com UX/Product na definição de jornadas do usuário, fluxos de navegação e experiências digitais.
  • Levantar e detalhar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais (performance, usabilidade, segurança, disponibilidade).

Estruturação de requisitos para desenvolvimento

  • Traduzir necessidades em épicos, features e histórias de usuário , alinhadas à visão e roadmap do produto.
  • Definir critérios de aceite objetivos e testáveis , considerando cenários positivos, negativos e de borda.
  • Apoiar a decomposição de demandas visando incrementos pequenos e entregáveis .

Atuação em squads ágeis

  • Participar ativamente de refinamentos, plannings, reviews e cerimônias de produto , esclarecendo dúvidas funcionais e de negócio.
  • Atuar como referência funcional para desenvolvedores mobile/web, QA e UX .
  • Apoiar decisões técnicas avaliando impactos em experiência do usuário, dados e integrações.

Integrações e dados

  • Analisar e especificar integrações via APIs , fluxos entre sistemas e consumo/exposição de dados.
  • Garantir consistência entre front-end, back-end e serviços de apoio.
  • Trabalhar com eventos, estados da aplicação e regras de negócio distribuídas.

Qualidade e validação

  • Apoiar testes funcionais e UAT , garantindo aderência da solução ao comportamento esperado do usuário.
  • Validar entregas com base em critérios de aceite, fluxos e métricas definidas no discovery.
  • Contribuir para melhoria contínua do produto com base em feedbacks, métricas e incidentes.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação completa em áreas correlatas.
  • Português fluente.
  • Experiência sólida como Analista de Negócios / Requisitos em produtos digitais ou aplicativos .
  • Vivência prática em squads ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).
  • Escrita e detalhamento de user stories , critérios de aceite e cenários.
  • Experiência com discovery de produto , entendimento de problema e validação de hipóteses.
  • Conhecimento em UX básico : jornadas, fluxos, wireframes e usabilidade.
  • Capacidade de análise de integrações, APIs e fluxos sistêmicos .
  • Uso de ferramentas de backlog e produto (ex.: Jira ou similares).

Requisitos Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou forte proximidade com gestão de produto digital.
  • Vivência com BDD , Given/When/Then.
  • Experiência com aplicativos mobile (iOS/Android) e/ou plataformas web.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de produto (ex.: conversão, engajamento, funil, erro).
  • Atuação em produtos de escala, alta disponibilidade ou múltiplos perfis de usuário.

description:

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências – Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação – são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Supervisionar as intervenções realizadas pela equipe multidisciplinar;

Atuar como ponto de equilíbrio em divergências técnicas entre profissionais de diferentes áreas para garantir uma abordagem transdisciplinar.

Gerenciar a interação, por meio da participação de reuniões, elaboração de materiais e de relatórios a fim de melhorar a qualidade da adesão e monitoramento;

Liderar reuniões clínicas semanais para discutir casos complexos ou estagnação no desenvolvimento de usuários específicos;

Identificar necessidades de treinamento e organizar momentos de capacitação técnica (ex: cursos em ABA, Denver, comunicação suplementar);

Desenvolver programas de orientação para que as famílias possam dar continuidade às estratégias de manejo comportamental em casa;

Coordenar visitas técnicas ou reuniões com os professores dos usuários para alinhar o Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) escolar com o plano clínico;

Organizar a agenda da equipe, controlando faltas, reposições e otimizando a lista de espera.

  • Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia, Fisioterapia, Fonoaudiólogo, Terapeuta Ocupacional ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável Pós-Graduação;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Coordenador e na área de atuação da reabilitação;

Horário de Trabalho: 40h semanais

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Creator Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

Darkroom is hiring a Creator Manager to lead client-facing creator strategy and execution across our Creator Services division. This role owns the relationship between brands and our creator network — ensuring campaigns are strategically aligned, operationally sound, and performance‑driven across platforms, including TikTok Shop, Amazon affiliate, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging commerce channels.

As a Creator Manager, you will serve as the primary point of contact for both clients and creators. You will shape activation strategy, oversee execution, and ensure creator output drives measurable impact while maintaining a strong creator experience. If you thrive at the intersection of relationships, strategy, and commerce — this role was built for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Creator Strategy & Client Leadership: Lead creator and influencer strategy across client accounts, serving as the primary client‑facing point of contact — presenting strategy, performance insights, and optimization recommendations.
  • Campaign Execution: Own end‑to‑end execution of creator campaigns, including sourcing, vetting, contracting, onboarding, and performance tracking.
  • Platform Activation: Activate creators across TikTok Shop, affiliate programs, paid UGC, Amazon, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging channels.
  • Commerce & Creative Alignment: Partner with the Account team and Content Studio to align creator efforts to hero SKUs, commission strategy, and creative frameworks.
  • Performance Monitoring: Track campaign performance and proactively recommend optimization opportunities.
  • Network & Operations: Manage usage rights, timelines, deliverables, CRM systems, and Darkroom's creator network infrastructure.
  • Team Development: Mentor junior team members and help scale best practices within Creator Services.

Who You Are

  • 3–6 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, UGC, or affiliate programs.
  • Strong client management experience and comfort leading strategy conversations.
  • Deep understanding of creator workflows, usage rights, and cross‑platform activation.
  • Experience with TikTok Shop and affiliate models preferred; exposure to Amazon affiliate, LTK, or YouTube Shopping is a plus.
  • Analytical and performance‑oriented, with the ability to translate creator output into measurable impact.
  • Highly organized and confident managing multiple clients and creator pipelines simultaneously.
  • Strong communicator with a creator‑first mindset and commercial awareness.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Social Investment Senior Advisor
description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Job Family Group: Corporate Relations

Worker Type: Regular

Posting Start Date: December 9, 2025

Business Unit: CoS and Corporate Relations

Experience Level: Experienced Professionals

What’s the role

You will be a key player in our Societal Impact and Energy Transition program team in Shell Brasil’s Corporate Relations team. One of our objectives is to create a positive presence and legacy in the communities and countries in which we operate and to be a trusted and responsible neighbour. We do this by engaging with our communities, identifying and mitigating the social impacts of our operations, and delivering benefits through social investment. You will be working closely with the Societal Impact and Energy Transition Program Manager and business colleagues in the country, as well as the regional and global Social Performance Centre of Excellence in Shell.

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing and implementing a robust social investment strategy for Shell in Brazil that is aligned with our business objectives in-country, Shell’s Group social investment strategy and requirements, and the social context of our communities
  • Identifying and designing meaningful social investment programmes in line with the strategy
  • Selecting and managing delivery partners to help us implement our social investment programmes
  • Driving implementation of the social investment programmes, with clear oversight and regular review of performance against goals and targets
  • Developing and executing monitoring, evaluation, and learning plans for our social investment programmes, jointly with our delivery partners
  • Undertaking social baseline and evaluation studies as needed to help inform and continuously improve social investment programmes
  • Developing and implementing impact-led communication plans for internal and external stakeholders
  • Engaging leaders to create a shared vision and internal alignment on Shell Brazil social investment objectives and activities
  • Representing Shell externally and engaging with a broad range of stakeholders including communities, government, joint venture partners, civil society organisations, among others
  • Proactively identifying and managing risks to the social investment programmes, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to ensure the programmes remain externally relevant, impactful, and efficient
  • Developing and coordinating the disaster response plans for supporting communities where needed
  • Ensuring compliance with Shell’s business principles, ethics, and compliance standards
  • Ensuring budget and activity planning and tracking progress, and compliance with Shell’s global reporting requirements for social investment spend and outcomes

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • 15+ years of experience with qualifications relevant to social development
  • Significant experience and proven track record in designing and delivering social development programmes, in particular related to STEM skills, enterprise development, and livelihood programmes
  • Experience working with corporates in designing and delivering social programmes with a good understanding of business processes and influencing senior business leaders
  • Extensive external network in the development sector to help create strong collaborations and partnerships
  • Experience managing external delivery partners
  • Experience in developing monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks; measuring and reporting impacts
  • Strategic and critical thinking skills to design and develop new programmes, and the ability to troubleshoot and solve problems
  • Strong communication (written and verbal), presentation, and facilitation skills; business fluency in English is a minimum requirement
  • Excellent collaboration, stakeholder influencing, and management skills across organizational boundaries and different levels of seniority, without direct authority
  • Ability to uphold high‑quality standards, anticipate and manage risks
  • Excellent project/programme management skills
  • Solid team leadership skills
  • Learner Mindset – role model curiosity and reflection, and encourage people to learn from mistakes and successes
  • Maximise performance – integrate and collaborate across boundaries to maximise commercial value for the organisation as a whole

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance‑related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. When you join us, you will have:

The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.

You’ll help consulting teams with research requirements on client projects on all oil & gas related matters.

You will be responsible for working with consultants to scope and prioritize their research needs, identifying the key issues through discussions with requestors and, on that basis, determining the most appropriate, cost‑effective, and timely research solutions. You will then gather the necessary raw information using a broad spectrum of sources and will organize, analyze, and synthesize the findings into targeted, McKinsey‑formatted end products. These end products may be in the form of single exhibits, written summaries, basic fact packs, and spreadsheets.

Additionally, you are encouraged to build a solid knowledge base, developing an appropriately broad understanding of the relevant structure, players, and trends in your topic area(s) and deepening your expertise over time.

Como uma pessoa assessora sênior de impostos diretos, você será parte de Tax atuando em vários projetos globais e locais na área de Global Compliance and Reporting (GCR), ajudando grandes empresas a administrar e reduzir os riscos de suas operações, e assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:
